summary: REQ-4 appears implemented by invoking updateRuntimePublicUrl() on app startup (via App.tsx) and removing console logging from runtimePublicUrl.ts. The diff also includes multiple unrelated UI/content and feature changes not requested by the BuildRequest (based on the provided file summaries).
